about.title: About Me
about.bio: AI Tech Lead and consultant with 8+ years shipping production software. I lead AI engineering at WotDev and advise companies on putting AI into real products — deciding where an LLM actually earns its place, then taking it from prototype to production. Before that I built at scale: sports streaming on Apple TV (SNY, FanDuel) and global travel platforms (Lonely Planet). Based in Lima, Peru, working globally.

skills.ai_blurb: Deciding where an LLM earns its place in a product — and where it doesn't. Prompt and context design, evaluation, streaming UX, cost and latency tradeoffs, and the guardrails production use requires.
